data.name: VoidFire
data.detailed_description:
VoidFire is a PvP shooter driven by horror tension, with matches unfolding inside unstable Void arenas. Combat starts immediately and offers no time to adjust — the space itself and the entities within it constantly interfere.

Noise is a signal.

Every shot, step, and reload spreads across the arena. The space hears the fight and reacts.

The arena turns hostile.

Passages change shape, lights cut out, and landmarks vanish. The map stops being reliable and demands constant awareness.

The Void is inhabited.

Creatures move in the dark. Activity draws them in. They break the flow of combat and attack everyone without distinction.

Fear speeds things up.

Horror works alongside fast pacing: sudden clashes, unexpected interference, and chaotic moments, followed by brief pauses before the next spike of tension.

Features:

• Full-featured PvP horror shooter

• Small arenas with limited visibility

• Creatures that interfere with PvP combat

• Unstable, shifting environments

• A blend of tension, chaos, and fun

VoidFire keeps players moving.

Stop — and you’re heard.

Hesitate — and you’re late.

Lights out — shoot by sound.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2 GB
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • Storage: 40000 MB available space
